/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, gzip
base='/workspace/data'
sc=pd.read_csv(base+'/spatial_q_sc_counts.csv', index_col=0)
meta=pd.read_csv(base+'/spatial_q_sc_metadata.csv', index_col=0)
# load spot counts from generated dense tsv
bulk=pd.read_csv(base+'/bulk_exprs.tsv', sep='\\t', index_col=0)
spot=bulk['Spot_710-1']
# compute mean per type and correlations
from scipy.stats import pearsonr, spearmanr
print('spot nonzero', (spot>0).sum(), 'sum', spot.sum())
for ct, group in meta.groupby('cell_type'):
    cells=sc.loc[group.index]
    mean=cells.mean(axis=0)
    p=pearsonr(spot, mean)[0]; s=spearmanr(spot, mean)[0]
